sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID 
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND E.Thrombosis = 1 AND YEAR(E.`Examination Date`) = 1997

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000 AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997'

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services' AND major.major_name = 'education'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.college 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.date,
        l.amount,
        c.gender
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN 
        client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'M'
),
loan_1996 AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_1996
    FROM 
        loan_data
    WHERE 
        STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1996'
),
loan_1997 AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_1997
    FROM 
        loan_data
    WHERE 
        STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997'
)
SELECT 
    ((total_amount_1997 - total_amount_1996) / total_amount_1996) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan_1996, loan_1997

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM trans 
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date > '1995-12-31'

SELECT SUM(amount) 
FROM trans 
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id 
    FROM disp 
    WHERE client_id = 617
) AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'

SELECT client_id, birth_date
FROM client
WHERE district_id IN (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'East Bohemia'
)
AND strftime('%Y', birth_date) BETWEEN '1983' AND '1987'

SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_spent_on_food
FROM expense
WHERE link_to_budget IN (
    SELECT budget_id
    FROM budget
    WHERE category = 'Food' AND link_to_event IN (
        SELECT event_id
        FROM event
        WHERE event_name = 'September Meeting'
    )
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN `order` o ON d.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976'
  AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND o.amount > 4000

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun' AND strftime('%Y', account.date) > '1996'

SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_spent 
FROM expense 
WHERE link_to_budget IN (
    SELECT budget_id 
    FROM budget 
    WHERE category = 'Advertisement' AND link_to_event IN (
        SELECT event_id 
        FROM event 
        WHERE event_name = 'September Meeting'
    )
)

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) = '1920' AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
AND County = 'Stanislaus' 
AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE ClosedDate BETWEEN '1989-01-01' AND '1989-12-31' 
  AND City = 'San Francisco' 
  AND DOCType = 'Community College District'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE borderColor = 'white' AND (power IS NULL OR power = '*')

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName 
FROM users u 
JOIN votes v ON u.Id = v.UserId 
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id 
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50 AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT 
    ((ld.overall_rating - jb.overall_rating) * 100.0 / ld.overall_rating) AS percentage_difference
FROM 
    Player_Attributes ld, 
    Player_Attributes jb
WHERE 
    ld.player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') 
    AND jb.player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')
    AND ld.date = '2013-07-12' 
    AND jb.date = '2013-07-12'

SELECT drivers.nationality 
FROM drivers 
JOIN qualifying ON drivers.driverId = qualifying.driverId 
WHERE qualifying.raceId = 355 AND qualifying.q2 = '0:01:40'

SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 
FROM connected 
WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) 
FROM client AS T1 
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', T1.birth_date) < '1950' AND T2.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT drivers.nationality 
FROM drivers 
JOIN qualifying ON drivers.driverId = qualifying.driverId 
WHERE qualifying.raceId = 347 AND qualifying.q2 = '0:01:15'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996'

SELECT Laboratory.PLT 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'

SELECT 
    T1.account_id, 
    T2.A2 AS district, 
    T2.A3 AS region
FROM 
    loan AS T1
JOIN 
    account AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN 
    district AS T2 ON T3.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE 
    T1.amount > 300000

SELECT C.client_id, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', C.birth_date) AS age
FROM client C
JOIN disp D ON C.client_id = D.client_id
JOIN card CA ON D.disp_id = CA.disp_id
WHERE D.type = 'OWNER' AND CA.type = 'gold'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.amount >= 250000 
AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' 
AND loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) 
FROM client c 
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id 
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id 
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT card.type 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE disp.client_id = 9

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id) 
FROM account AS T1 
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id 
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND T2.amount < 200000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND district.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000

SELECT AVG(T2.A15) 
FROM account AS T1 
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
WHERE T2.A4 > 4000 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) >= '1997'

SELECT T1.A2 AS district_name, T1.A3 AS region 
FROM district AS T1 
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
JOIN loan AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id 
WHERE T3.loan_id = 4990

SELECT T2.account_id 
FROM client AS T1 
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id 
JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id 
WHERE T1.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client) 
ORDER BY T3.A11 DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT disp.disp_id 
FROM disp 
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id 
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id 
WHERE trans.amount = 5100 AND trans.date BETWEEN '1998-09-02' AND '1998-09-03'

SELECT NCESSchool 
FROM schools 
ORDER BY enroll12 DESC 
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles' 
AND schools.Charter = 0 
AND `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT s.Website, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT DISTINCT T2.expense_description 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member 
WHERE T1.t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'

SELECT b.budget_id, b.category, MAX(e.cost) AS max_cost
FROM budget b
JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE e.expense_description LIKE '%Water, chips, cookies%'
GROUP BY b.budget_id, b.category
ORDER BY max_cost DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT location FROM event WHERE event_name = 'Spring Budget Review'

SELECT category, amount 
FROM budget 
WHERE link_to_event = (SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_name = 'January Speaker')
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.player_api_id, p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.balance = (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND pa.potential = 61

SELECT DISTINCT c.name 
FROM constructors c 
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId 
WHERE cs.position = 1

SELECT circuits.name 
FROM races 
JOIN circuits ON races.circuitid = circuits.circuitid 
WHERE races.year = 2009 AND races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND m.label = '+'
